name: Quad Cortex
author: Nick Lozano
description: Neural DSP Quad Cortex in the Omarchy bar while Cortex Control runs: show or hide the editor, switch scenes, toggle the tuner and set the QC's audio.

barWidget.description: Shows whether the Quad Cortex is connected, opens Cortex Control and runs cortex-control-doctor.

schema.label: Show icon
schema.description: running: only while Cortex Control is open (default). connected: also while the Quad Cortex is plugged in and on. always: never hide.
